name: Crac-Man
author: robotrods
description: This is a take-off from the original Pac-man game. The Crac-Man snorts his way through the maze, then at certain locations, snorts up an eight-ball of cocaine, then goes after the police. This all takes place in Crac-man hell, so no character are actually hurt in the game, as it takes special methods, to hurt ghosts; which all the character are.
